product.title: Private Mountain and Desert Adventure from San Diego

description.text: Head into mountain and desert terrain outside San Diego on a private guided adventure designed for travelers seeking rugged scenery and flexible pacing. The route combines scenic drives, short trail walks, and remote viewpoints.
